flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and noted its displayed price of $49.00.
Added the earbuds to the cart without selecting extras and ensured the cart contained only that item.
Continued through checkout with simple test information to the final review page, without entering payment details or placing an order.
The final review showed a total of $49.00 and no additional fees.
one_liner: completed checkout review for AirWave Pro Earbuds on the local store

cart_unadded_items_check.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the order total amount in the review page order summary
final_total.condition: the final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}
final_total.human_description: Reading the final order total from the review summary

extra_fees.query: the names of non-free fees in the review page order summary
extra_fees.condition: the names of any fees added on top of the product price are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none")
extra_fees.human_description: Reading any additional fees from the review summary
extra_fees.code_js: (() => { const fees = [...el(9).querySelectorAll('.row:not(.total)')].map(r => ({ name: r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim() ?? '', amount: r.querySelector('span:last-child')?.textContent.trim() ?? '' })).filter(x => !x.name.includes('×') && x.amount.toLowerCase() !== 'free').map(x => x.name).filter(Boolean); return fees.length ? fees.join(', ') : 'none'; })()
